connections.subtitle: REST endpoint
connections.description: Connect to an agent running as a local or remote HTTP service.
limitations: the endpoint must accept the documented JSON request body and return 'output' (and optionally 'tool_calls')
authentication headers are held in memory for this process only
a non-2xx response is a technical failure, never a blocked attack

connections.subtitle: Read-only inbox
connections.description: Evaluate real NEMESIS_DEMO Gmail messages through the existing read-only OAuth token and local Ollama analysis engine.
requires: at least one NEMESIS_DEMO-labelled message for a live turn
limitations: only gmail.readonly is accepted; no send, modify or delete scope
analysis is detection and recommendation only; no Gmail write is executed
a model or OAuth failure is a technical failure, never a blocked attack

connections.subtitle: LangGraph ReAct agent
connections.description: Connect a real LangChain agent (langchain.agents.create_agent) on a local Ollama model. The model is actually invoked at run time.
limitations: the agent's tools are Nemesis-provided stubs; whether the model calls a tool is decided by the real model, never faked
only this LangGraph ReAct construction is claimed supported; arbitrary user LangChain agents are not auto-imported
a model/transport error is a technical failure, never a blocked attack

catalog.detects: literal taint marker present in data reaching a tool
catalog.blocks: denies the tool call when the marker is visible
catalog.does_not: does not perform control/data-flow separation; encoded, homoglyph or split payloads are not detected

catalog.detects: tool calls outside the declared schema or task intent
catalog.blocks: denies calls whose schema/intent check fails
catalog.does_not: rule-based schema and intent matching only; no model-based intent analysis

catalog.display_name: Progent-style privilege control (LOCAL PROXY — no SMT solver)
catalog.detects: tool calls above the privilege ceiling or with risky arguments
catalog.blocks: denies calls exceeding max_privilege or violating string checks
catalog.does_not: NO SMT solver and NO formal verification: a privilege table plus pattern checks. Do not describe it as Progent or as SMT solving.
catalog.upstream_system: Progent — NOT reproduced here (no solver dependency)

catalog.detects: tool calls not matching the allowlist or violating JSON-Schema argument constraints
catalog.blocks: denies via secagent.check_tool_call at the checker boundary; deny-by-default for any tool with no allow rule. This replay invokes the checker after the target call returns, so enforcement timing is reported per case and a post-hoc denial is never credited as prevention.
catalog.does_not: the vendored paper-reference checker performs rule/schema enforcement, NOT the paper's SMT constraint solving; no formal-verification claim
catalog.upstream_system: Progent (sunblaze-ucb/progent, MIT) — pinned source vendored and used

catalog.display_name: CaMeL (real Google core — provenance + default-deny policy)
catalog.detects: private/untrusted data (or a value derived from it) flowing into a privileged tool call, via real CaMeL provenance tracking
catalog.blocks: denies at the CaMeL SecurityPolicyEngine boundary; default-deny on non-public arguments. This replay invokes the checker after the target call returns, so enforcement timing is reported per case and a post-hoc denial is never credited as prevention.
catalog.does_not: PARTIAL integration: the real interpreter/capability engine enforces policy, but the quarantined/privileged LLM planner and AgentDojo pipeline are not reproduced; replay supplies tool_name/arguments and provenance is adapter-constructed from the payload boundary, so no universal security guarantee is claimed

defense_implementation.does_not: PARTIAL integration: the real interpreter/capability engine enforces policy, but the quarantined/privileged LLM planner and AgentDojo pipeline are not reproduced; replay supplies tool_name/arguments and provenance is adapter-constructed from the payload boundary, so no universal security guarantee is claimed
